minutes_text:
CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MINUTES
  FRIDAY, MAY 9, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  4TH FLOOR, QUEEN MARY CONFERENCE ROOM, 9:00 AM

Robyn Gordon-Peterson, President  Gloria Cordero, Commissioner
Chief Coleman, Commissioner  Sharon Weissman, Commissioner

Omar Ramos, Manager of Administration –
Human Resources

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

CALL TO ORDER

At 9:03 AM, President Gordon-Peterson called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Coleman, Cordero, Weissman, Gordon-Peterson

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

President Gordon-Peterson led the Pledge of Allegiance.

PUBLIC COMMENT

There was no public comment.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55142  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Civil Service Commission Special
  Meeting of April 17, 2025.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Weissman, seconded by
  Commissioner Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Cordero, Weissman, Gordon-Peterson
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Coleman

2.  25-55135  Closed Session – Personnel Session Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54957(B)(1).

  Page 1 of 3
   CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MINUTES
  FRIDAY, MAY 9, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  4TH FLOOR, QUEEN MARY CONFERENCE ROOM, 9:00 AM

  At 9:06 AM, there being no objection, President Gordon-Peterson recessed to
  Closed Session.

  Commissioner Coleman joined the meeting.

  At 9:46 PM, President Gordon-Peterson reconvened the meeting.

3.  25-55136  Recommendation to approve protest of written examination – Fire Captain.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Weissman, seconded by President
  Gordon-Peterson, to approve recommendation, as amended, to accept the
  protest for Item 24, and deny the protest for Item 29. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Coleman, Weissman, Gordon-Peterson
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Cordero

  President Gordon-Peterson spoke.

  Commissioner Weissman spoke.

PUBLIC COMMENT

There was no public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Commissioner Weissman spoke.

Commissioner Coleman spoke.

President Gordon-Peterson spoke.

ADJOURNMENT

At 9:52 AM, there being no objection, President Gordon-Peterson declared the meeting adjourned.
